name: White Garland-lily
desc: White Garland-lily (Hedychium coronarium): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 36 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hedychium coronarium, the white garland-lily or white ginger lily, is a perennial flowering plant in the ginger family, Zingiberaceae. It is native to the forest understorey of Asia.
